subject: Marketplace Vendor Onboarding: Pre-Go-Live Checklist & PO Coordination
messages:
From: Markus Lang <markus@cloudbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace vendor go-live: billing & PO questions

Hi Rachel / Vanessa,

Thanks for moving us through the onboarding. We're aiming to go live on the marketplace next Wednesday (7/28) but have a few procurement/billing items to confirm before we can finalize the listing date: 

1) PO requirements — our procurement team needs a Redwood PO acceptance template or a sample invoice line item that maps to marketplace SKUs. We attached our internal PO template (acme_po_template.pdf) for reference.
2) Marketplace billing path — will invoices be routed to Redwood Finance or handled through the marketplace (AWS/GCP) billing flow? If through the marketplace, please confirm what our invoice should reference (Listing ID / SKU / Seller ID).
3) Effective date — we need the exact service effective date to put on the PO. Can you confirm the earliest date Redwood can accept?

Also, Markus here — we have both AWS and Azure listings planned; any platform-specific forms we need to complete now?

Appreciate a quick checklist so we can loop in procurement and avoid go-live delay.

Thanks,
Markus Lang
Partnerships Manager, CloudBridge
markus@cloudbridge.com

Hi Markus — great questions. Below is a concise pre-go-live checklist and the info procurement needs. I'm looping in Ben (finance & billing) and Karthik (marketplace onboarding) to handle platform specifics.

Pre-Go-Live checklist (high-level)
- Confirm PO recipient and whether Redwood or marketplace will invoice (see Ben's notes).
- Provide the PO number and the desired effective date (we can accept 7/28 if PO is issued by 7/26, otherwise push to 8/4).
- Complete AWS/Azure seller forms (Karthik: will attach the AWS seller intake and required Seller ID mapping).
- SKU mapping: we need the exact SKU/code you plan to publish; if not yet finalized, provide product short-name and we will map to a listing ID.
- Legal/Tax: if CloudBridge requires invoices to include VAT or tax registration numbers, provide those now.

Platform notes:
- For AWS Marketplace, billing usually flows through AWS when using the Marketplace Metering model. Alternatively, for private offers we can accept a Redwood-invoice flow (requires PO to Redwood Finance).
- For Azure, billing often goes via Partner Center or direct invoice depending on the offer type.

Next steps / Asks from CloudBridge
1) Send official PO (PDF) with requested effective date and billing contact.
2) Confirm which marketplaces (AWS / Azure / GCP) you want to activate on day 1.
3) Provide SKU or product short-name for listing.

I attached the internal AWS seller intake form (aws_seller_onboarding_form.xlsx) and will follow up with Karthik's step-by-step for AWS/Azure.

Thanks — I can sync with Procurement if you'd like me to field the incoming PO.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Hi all — quick finance note and routing instructions to make this smooth: 

1) Preferred flow: If CloudBridge wants Redwood to invoice directly, Procurement should issue a PO referencing Redwood Inference (TIN 12-3456789) and the relevant Listing ID or SKU. The PO should be sent to procurement@redwood.com and cc finance@redwood.com.

2) Marketplace flow (AWS/Azure/GCP): If you're transacting through AWS Marketplace Metering, billing and invoicing will be handled by AWS; CloudBridge will receive a consolidated monthly invoice from AWS. In that case, include the AWS Listing ID and Seller ID in your PO comments for our reconciliation.

3) PO fields we need (sample lines):
- PO number: [ACME-XXXXX]
- Effective date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
- Billing contact: name/email
- SKU / Listing ID: [e.g., RBC-ML-INFER-01]
- Payment terms: Net 30 (unless otherwise agreed)

4) If you plan to use a Private Offer via Marketplace, we need the DocuSign link for the Private Offer acceptance. I can prepare a vendor acceptance template if needed (I uploaded a draft to the shared drive).

DocuSign / HubSpot links:
- DocuSign (private offer template): https://docusign.redwood.com/CB-4831-PO
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deals/CB-4831

If CloudBridge can get a PO to us by EOD Monday (7/26), we can keep the 7/28 go-live target. Otherwise, recommend moving to 8/4 to allow finance processing.

—Ben
Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
